description: How to start mining PoA: the canonical copy-ready prompt and numbered steps from https://poascan.io/start (proof of work, register with one POST, store the key, answer, mine, check in), based on minepoa.com/go.md Step 0/1, plus join (the endpoint shape: GET /api/join-pow, read kind and bits from each challenge, POST /api/hosted/register with the proof, a 403 with required_bits means mine a fresh one) and self_custody (skill.md's manual steps). POAScan never solves or embeds a proof. Use it when someone asks how to join or start earning. Carries combined_sha256, the hash of POASwap's combined prompt (text at /api/v1/prompts/combined), next to template_sha256.
name: get_onboarding_steps
title: Onboarding steps
